checks.name: locator-normalisation-equivalence-table
checks.summary: A4's table asserted as a table: https://github.com/O/N, https://github.com/O/N.git, git@github.com:O/N.git and https://GitHub.com/o/n all normalise to {forge:github host:github.com owner:o name:n}, together with http://, ssh://, git://, an explicit port form, github.com/O/N and the bare O/N form -- eleven spellings, one locator, one key github/o/n. A userinfo-bearing URL form is also asserted to normalise to the same locator with the userinfo dropped, so no field of the stored coordinate can retain it. Rejected: empty locator, whitespace, a single segment, three segments, an empty owner or name, an owner or name containing / or backslash, a host containing /, an unknown forge, and a default branch containing a backslash or whitespace. Parsing is hand-written because internal/domain admits no net/url import.

checks.name: decide-and-validate-closure
checks.summary: register is the 0->1 transition of a Repository that carries its identity and locator but no status; retire is registered->retired. Both bump Version, so the store's optimistic concurrency has exactly one thing to compare. Refusals asserted: missing actor, zero timestamp, stale expected version, unknown command kind, empty repository id, empty locator, double retire, re-register over a registered record, unknown status, non-normalised locator, unknown requested_by actor type. A zero RequestedBy stays legitimate, exactly as on Requirement. RepositoryStatus is closed at exactly registered and retired; the aggregate is never deleted.

checks.name: observation-staleness-uses-injected-clock
checks.summary: A21: every staleness question is answered against an explicitly supplied instant. No test in repository_test.go sleeps, starts a goroutine, sets a timer or reads a wall clock; the package's own source guard forbids time.Now in any non-test file outright. RepositoryExecutabilityFrom is asserted to return an explicit "unobserved" state with a reason when no Observation exists, and never a plausible-looking executable/blocked verdict; the retired, control-denied, unreachable, no-push, no-default-branch and stale cases are each asserted separately.

checks.name: a7-no-assignee-owner-acl-or-runner-field
checks.summary: Asserted from repository.go's AST, not by review: Repository's field set is exactly {ID, Locator, Status, Version, RequestedBy} and nothing else, and none of those names matches the forbidden list (assignee, acl, permission, runnerid, ownerid, member, role, token, secret, credential, password, apikey). The matcher carries its own positive control: AssigneeID, RunnerID, ACL, PermissionSet and AccessToken must all match it, so the scan cannot pass vacuously. RepositoryObservation is separately asserted to carry no runner identifier field.
